context_requirements: Active TNF production or TNF-driven autocrine/paracrine signaling
Myeloid or lymphoid lineage with competent TLR/NF-kB inflammatory signaling
Presence of an inflammatory stimulus to induce TNF transcription
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of TNF-responsive landmark genes such as NFKBIA, NFKB2, NFKBIE, CXCL2, CCL2, ICAM1, or TNFAIP3 at 6 h or 24 h in any line
Dose-dependent suppression of an inflammatory gene signature across multiple lines
Consistent changes in proliferation, apoptosis, or stress programs attributable to TNF pathway inhibition
